_fixture: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Fictional client. No real Service Provider client data. Assess variant (advisory, readout-gated, fixed fee).

projectContext.businessNeed: Calder Diagnostics has grown through three acquisitions in four years and now runs two Salesforce orgs plus an inherited CPQ estate nobody owns. Leadership needs an independent read on whether to consolidate, re-platform, or hold, before committing next year's capital budget.
projectContext.businessDriver: Two Salesforce orgs and an unowned CPQ estate ahead of a capital budget decision.

sourceSystem: Two production Salesforce orgs and a legacy CPQ managed package
engagementBoundary: This is an advisory engagement. Service Provider assesses the current estate and delivers a recommendation and roadmap. No system is built, configured, or deployed.
boundarySummary: Assessment and recommendation only. No build, no configuration, no deployment.
exclusions: Any configuration, development, or deployment in either Salesforce org.
Data migration or data remediation of any kind.
Vendor negotiation or license procurement on Calder's behalf.
A detailed implementation estimate. The assessment sizes the direction in rough order of magnitude; a priced implementation plan is a separate engagement.

phases.name: Discover
phases.purpose: Stakeholder sessions and estate information gathering.

phases.name: Assess
phases.purpose: Analysis and findings against the in-scope areas.

phases.name: Recommend
phases.purpose: Roadmap, prioritization, and the executive readout.

scopeItems.name: Org and estate inventory
scopeItems.description: A documented inventory of both Salesforce orgs and the legacy CPQ estate, covering objects, automation, integrations, and license consumption. Establishes the factual baseline the recommendation rests on.
scopeItems.assumptions: Calder provides read-only access to both production orgs within the first three business days. Up to 12 stakeholder interviews are conducted.

scopeItems.name: Technical debt and risk findings
scopeItems.description: Findings on technical debt, unsupported customization, and operational risk across the estate, each rated and evidenced. Identifies what is load-bearing and what is abandoned.
scopeItems.assumptions: Findings are based on configuration inspection and stakeholder input. No code-level security audit or penetration testing is performed.

scopeItems.name: Consolidation options analysis
scopeItems.description: A comparison of the viable directions, consolidate, re-platform, or hold, with the trade-offs, risks, and rough order-of-magnitude effort for each. Gives leadership a defensible basis for the capital decision.
scopeItems.assumptions: Options are sized in rough order of magnitude only. A firm implementation estimate requires a separate scoping engagement.

scopeItems.name: Recommended roadmap and executive readout
scopeItems.description: A sequenced roadmap for the recommended direction, presented in an executive readout with the findings and the reasoning behind the recommendation. This is the deliverable the engagement is accepted on.
scopeItems.assumptions: One executive readout session is included. Additional readouts to other audiences are scheduled separately.
